{{Top|leg}}
'''Personal Data Journal Entry #481''' was an entry made into personal data journals owned by various high ranking members of the first Death Star. The commanding officer of the battlestation, Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin implemented a section into the journal entry, detailing both the weapon systems and the energy and propulsion systems aboard the Death Star, the latter of which was also included in [[Personal Data Journal Entry 461|Personal Data Journal Entry #461]].
